subject: Eval onramp — ops roster, acceptance sprint and POC acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@finnova.com>, Dan Cho <dan.cho@finnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval onramp: ops roster + acceptance sprint

Hi Elena / Dan —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and the immediate asks so we can lock the POC scope and kickoff: 

Summary of today's agreement:
- 4-week POC focused on inference latency & throughput for Finnova's document-parsing flow (sample sizes: ~10k docs/day).
- Redwood will provide a hosted trial environment with a dedicated GPU pool for the run; Finnova will give a representative sample and a short set of golden prompts.

Proposed success criteria (attached as poc-success-criteria.xlsx):
1) Median response latency <= 220ms for 512-token prompts under defined load profile.
2) End-to-end throughput to sustain baseline 1k qps for burst windows (validated in week 2).
3) No PII exfiltration on a 500-message audit sample; security checks passed by Finnova security.
4) Integration verification: sample app can call the endpoint, auth flow passes, and traces are visible in Redwood Console.

Ownership ask (please confirm):
- Infra / network: Finnova platform eng (suggested: Dan Cho)
- App integration: Finnova product eng (we discussed Elena owning acceptance testing)
- Security / audit artifacts: Finnova security (please confirm owner for SOC2 artifacts)
- Procurement / SOW: procurement@finnova.com

Next steps / timeline:
- Action: Finnova to confirm owners + provide sample dataset by EOD 5/21.
- Redwood: share onramp-sprint-plan.pdf and enable trial env by 5/24.
- Kickoff call: propose Tue 5/27 10:00 AM PT (we can adjust).

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.xlsx, redwood-trial-arch-diagram.png

If any of the owners above should be different, reply with the right contact and we'll update the RACI.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@finnova.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Dan Cho <dan.cho@finnova.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval onramp: ops roster + acceptance sprint

Thanks Marcus — good summary. A few clarifications from our side before we lock owners: 

1) Data residency: we need the trial data to remain in us-west-2. Can you confirm the hosted trial will be in that region and that logs/traces won't cross regions?
2) SOC2 / security evidence: our security lead Lucia Ramos (copied below) will want the SOC2 report and a short matrix of what audit artifacts Redwood can provide.
3) Sample dataset: we can share a 10k-doc anonymized sample by Friday 5/21, but need to confirm the upload method (S3 bucket vs secure Share).
4) Procurement: procurement@finnova.com will expect an SOW; we'll need a high-level cost estimate for the reserved trial capacity so we can pre-approve the spend.

On owners — tentative internal assignments from Finnova:
- Infra: Dan Cho (Platform Eng) — will confirm resource allocation and VPC peering.
- App / acceptance testing: Elena Ortiz (Product).
- Security: Lucia Ramos (Security Manager) <lucia.ramos@finnova.com>.
- Procurement: procurement@finnova.com (procurement lead will reach out after we get the SOW).

Can Redwood confirm: region, artifacts, and preferred data ingestion path? Also can you share the onramp sprint sequence (deliverables per week) so our PM can line up engineers?

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Product Lead, Finnova
e.ortiz@finnova.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@finnova.com>, Dan Cho <dan.cho@finnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval onramp: ops roster + acceptance sprint

Elena — thanks for the details. Short answers up front: yes, trial environment will be provisioned in us-west-2; logs/traces will be kept in-region. Preferred ingestion is a temporary S3 bucket with a one-time presigned upload link (we'll provide instructions). SOC2 report and a short artifact matrix will be shared by Neha by EOD 5/21 (we typically provide SOC2 Type II summary + mapping for common controls).

I've sketched a RACI below and attached the onramp-sprint-plan.pdf with week-by-week milestones. Please review and confirm owners. 

RACI (proposed):
- Infra (Finnova) — Responsible: Dan Cho; Accountable: Finnova Platform Lead; Consulted: Ben Carter (Redwood infra liaison); Informed: PMs
- Trial env provisioning (Redwood) — Responsible: Ben Carter (Redwood); Accountable: Redwood Platform Ops
- Security evidence & audit questions — Responsible: Neha Kapoor (Redwood); Consulted: Lucia Ramos (Finnova); Accountable: Finnova Security Lead
- App integration & acceptance testing — Responsible: Elena Ortiz (Finnova); Consulted: Marissa Cole (Redwood); Accountable: Finnova Product Lead
- Procurement / SOW — Responsible: procurement@finnova.com; Consulted: Marcus Lin (Redwood)

Immediate action items (who / what / due):
- Finnova: confirm owners + send sample dataset (10k docs) — due 2027-05-21 EOD.
- Redwood (Ben): provision trial GPU pool and S3 presigned link — target 2027-05-24.
- Redwood (Neha): SOC2 summary & artifact matrix — target 2027-05-21 EOD.
- Redwood (Marissa): acceptance test plan and golden prompt set — target 2027-05-21.

If that looks good I'll lock the kickoff for Tue 5/27 10:00 AM PT and share a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Marcus

Quick ack from infra side. We'll do the following as part of provisioning: 
- Reserve 1 dedicated GPU node (NVIDIA H100 equivalent) for the trial window; allow burst to 2 nodes for load testing (week 2).
- Set up an IAM role and presigned S3 upload for the sample dataset; we will provide a short playbook with steps and a lifecycle rule to remove data after the trial.
- VPC peering and private endpoint: need Finnova network CIDR and point-of-contact (Dan) to schedule firewall/security exceptions.

I'll begin provisioning once we have confirmation of owners and the S3 path. Expect a provisioning ETA of 72 hours after the bucket is ready.

Ben Carter
Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
